schema_update_recommendations.recommendation: Add index on price for range queries
schema_update_recommendations.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_absorption_price_range ON absorption_events(symbol, price, timestamp DESC);

schema_update_recommendations.recommendation: Add materialized view for top absorption levels
schema_update_recommendations.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW top_absorption_levels AS SELECT symbol, price, side, COUNT(*) as event_count, AVG(significance_score) as avg_significance FROM absorption_events WHERE significance_score >= 0.6 GROUP BY symbol, price, side ORDER BY avg_significance DESC;
